event.name: Fireside Chat with Dr.Bartolomei
event.descriptionText:
Calling all surgery and spine enthusiasts, and anyone curious about the path to neurosurgery! Join us for a delicious dinner and a conversation with Dr. Bartolomei about his journey, career, and ERAS!

November 17; 5:30–6:45 PM; BCMM 101

Come hungry, bring your questions, and settle in for a great conversation. We’d love to see you there!
